name: privileged-debug
patch:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: privileged-debug
  namespace: default
spec:
  containers:
  - name: debug
    securityContext:
      capabilities:
        drop:
        - ALL
      seccompProfile:
        type: RuntimeDefault

name: privileged-debug
patch:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: privileged-debug
  namespace: default
spec:
  containers:
    - name: debug
      securityContext:
        allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 1000
